evidentiaryPhases.name: Phase 2: Accelerated Flipping & Nominee Transfers (Early 2017)

evidentiaryPhases.name: Phase 3: Sham Consulting & Opinion Shopping (Mid 2017 – 2018)
evidentiaryPhases.summary: Issuance of 25.5M+ shares to shell consultants (Delfin, Rubio, Hulbert, Phoenix Theater) with backdated agreements dating back 4 years to manufacture fake Rule 144 seasoning. Reliance on opinion letters by attorneys Stephen Mills and James Hintzen to strip legends.

evidentiaryPhases.name: Phase 4: Massive Offshore Straw Dumping (Early 2019)

Haas instructs Sanchez: 'Send 10M to Gaines and 17M back to me.'

evidentiaryPhases.name: Phase 5: Federal Indictment & Superior Court Actions (2020 – 2025)
